title: Transfers
subtitle: Send shares of a property or wallet balance to anyone by email — family, partners or friends.
emptyText: Transfers you send or receive appear here.

row.confirmCancel: Cancel this transfer? Everything comes back to you.

new.title: New transfer
new.noShares: You have no free shares to send (listed or offered shares are not free).
new.name: Recipient's name (optional)
new.rules: The shares / money are held from you now. The recipient receives them on the date if their account has a verified identity; otherwise we invite them and the transfer waits {{days}} days, then comes back to you. You can cancel until it is delivered.
new.errUnits: Choose a property and a number of shares you can send.
new.errAmount: Enter an amount your wallet covers (including any fee).
new.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

result.scheduled: Scheduled. {{email}} receives it on the chosen date.
result.waiting: Sent. {{email}} doesn't have a verified account yet — we invited them. They have {{days}} days to claim it, otherwise it comes back to you.
result.plan: Sent. {{email}} must accept the shares and their installments within {{days}} days; until then they stay with you.

new.noPlans: You have no installment plan whose shares can be sent now.
new.planTakeOver: The recipient takes over their part of the remaining installments: about {{amount}} over {{payments}} payment(s).
new.planKeep: You keep {{keep}} share(s) and your installments get smaller.
new.planWhole: The whole plan goes to the recipient.
new.planDue: An installment of this plan is due: pay it first to send part of the plan.
new.planRules: The recipient must accept the shares and their installments. If they decline or don't answer within {{days}} days, the shares stay with you. You can cancel until they accept.

plan.title: Installment shares waiting for your answer
plan.body: If you accept, the shares are yours and you take over their remaining installments: {{payments}} payment(s), {{total}} in total, charged from your wallet on their dates. Already paid for them: {{paid}}.
plan.due: The sender has an installment due on this plan; you can accept once it is paid.
plan.confirmDecline: Decline these shares? They stay with the sender.
